title: Uruguayan-Style Beef Empanadas
description: Flaky beef empanadas with a Uruguayan twist, perfect for a snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio works well

instructions: In a large skillet, heat a tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the ground beef, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Season with salt and cook until the beef is fully browned, about 5-7 minutes.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the beaten egg and mix until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto one half of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the beaten egg and fold the other half over the filling.
Press the edges to seal and use a fork to crimp.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
